changes.text: Fixed an issue which was causing many ambient sounds to be muted
The Neutropolis industrial zone is one area which should sound much livelier
The wait time to increase the size of an open league has been lowered from 5 minutes to 90 seconds.
This is the time that players in an Open league have to wait for so more players have time to join before the Incarnate Trial starts.
XP will now scale properly for leagues larger than 9 players.
League leaders should now be able to invite players into a league while on an Incarnate Trial map
Pets will no longer count against earning the Avoids the Green Stuff badge
Huge: Sideburns should now blend properly with Steampunk Beard
Female: Victorian Steampunk Bustier should no longer have clipping issues with tight and skin upper body
